newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: One dead, four lost in jungle plane crash.
newsitem.headline: One dead, four lost in jungle plane crash.

text.p: One man died, four passengers disappeared and four others were taken to hospitals when a light plane crashed into a river in the northwestern lowlands Thursday, emergency workers said.
The missing passengers might have been swept into the Chixoy River, Mario Cruz, a spokesman for the Guatemala City volunteer emergency squad, said.
"That's where they're looking for them," Cruz said.
The four survivors, including the pilot, were taken by helicopter to a Guatemala City hospital, Cruz said.
The twin-engine plane lost power in one engine and crashed at about 4 p.m. in the remote Ixcan jungle about three miles (5 km) from the Mexican border, Cruz said.
Little information was available due to difficulties communicating with officials in the area of the accident, he said.

The civilian aircraft was travelling from Playa Grande in the Ixcan region to the neighbouring province of Alta Verapaz, officials said. The route is commonly travelled by small commercial planes due to poor or non-existent roads into the Ixcan lowlands.
